analyst.summary: KEC International has a large order pipeline and strong headline returns on capital, but the business remains working-capital-intensive with only modest interest coverage, and the stock has been sharply de-rated over the past one to two years -- a signal that the market has real, ongoing concerns about execution and margin risk in EPC contracting rather than simply short-term sentiment. We would not hold through this without clearer evidence that working-capital and margin pressures have eased.
